And auto-replies that greet the customer by name and carry the ticket number.

GOOD TO KNOW

Nothing changes until you use it. Yaxxa AI is a plan feature that is off unless an operator or reseller switches it on, and an operator must connect the platform to the Yaxxa AI service first.

Not yet proven against the live Yaxxa AI service: it was built from the service's published interface and tested against stand-ins.

Two small changes to existing email auto-replies: a greeting with no name now reads "Hello," rather than "Hello ,", and an email with no subject is answered under "Re: Your message".

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Names and ticket numbers in auto-replies: the message when a conversation is handed to the team, the message when the team is closed, and every automatic reply rule now take placeholders, such as {{customer.firstName}}, {{customer.name}}, {{ticket.number}}, {{message.subject}}, {{tenant.name}} and {{opening.next}}. Give a fallback after a bar, as in {{customer.firstName|Customer}}, for when the name is not known. On email each message has its own subject. Pick placeholders from the Insert menu and see the result in the preview. Help has copy-and-paste examples under "Names and ticket numbers in auto-replies".

A ticket for each new email: a new setting on an email account opens a ticket before the auto-reply goes, so the reply carries its number, and the customer's answer lands on the same ticket.

Yaxxa AI (a plan feature): switch it on under Marketplace, with no key of your own. It gives you Yaxxa AI voices wherever the platform speaks (call flows, announcements, voicemail messages), transcripts of recordings with an English translation for calls in other languages, a live transcript on the agent's screen during calls, and Yaxxa AI as the AI model where your operator has connected it.

How words are said: a pronunciation list for names and brand words, used by every voice service.

Remove background noise: on a recorded or uploaded prompt, make a cleaned copy with Yaxxa AI. The original is kept.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS AND RESELLERS

Yaxxa AI: connect the platform to the Yaxxa AI service under Platform → Yaxxa AI (its address and key, and optionally its AI model's address). Test says separately whether the service can be reached, whether the key is accepted, and whether its certificate is trusted and matches. A private certificate authority can be trusted for this connection only. An address that is not https is accepted only where the server allows it, and the page warns that the key and audio then travel unencrypted.

Yaxxa AI is a new opt-in plan feature, with usage counted per thousand characters spoken and per minute transcribed. Cloned voices are offered to organisations only when consent is recorded for them."}
